name: gitbot
description: Housekeeping for branches and pull requests: reports CI status, merge conflicts and review state of agentpipe PRs, comments on PRs with pipeline reports, and lists branches safe to delete. Never merges.
when_to_use: When PRs pile up, after main moves and agentpipe branches may conflict, or to attach a summary comment to a PR. Not for code changes.
inputs: Which PRs or branches to look at, and what to do (report, comment, list stale).
outputs: A report; PR comments when asked. Merging and branch deletion stay with the human.
